description: This file defines React components and utility functions for managing and displaying snapshot views in a trace viewer UI, including snapshot collection, rendering, and inspection controls.

classes.name: HighlightedElement
classes.description: Type defining the highlighted element with optional locator and ariaSnapshot, and lastEdited state.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Type representing a snapshot associated with an action, including snapshot name, page ID, optional point, and input target flag.

classes.name: SnapshotInfo
classes.description: Type containing snapshot URL, viewport size, timestamp, and wallTime.

classes.name: Snapshots
classes.description: Type grouping action, before, and after snapshots.

classes.name: SnapshotUrls
classes.description: Type containing URLs for snapshot info, snapshot, and popout.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot object from an action and snapshot name key, with optional input target flag.

methods.name: collectSnapshots
methods.description: Collects and returns snapshots (action, before, after) related to a given action.

methods.name: extendSnapshot
methods.description: Generates URLs for snapshot, snapshot info, and popout based on trace URI and snapshot data.

methods.name: fetchSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Fetches snapshot metadata from a URL, returning URL, viewport, timestamp, and wallTime.
